component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.ui.operations.contrib
component.documentation:
AgenticUi.RunAction: runs one action of a business app's actions.json on the input record, as the app registry serves it, after checking the allow-list again and the user's permission on the record. Its parameters are the app's id, the action's id, and what the user entered in the action's form; never the operation.
AgenticUi.RequireRunAction: the first step of a chain meant for an app's button. It lets the chain go on only while AgenticUi.RunAction runs it, as the operation it names, and refuses every other way of running it, Nuxeo's own Automation endpoint and its dispatchers among them.
